key_points.point: Benchmarking must be problem-centric, reproducible, and distinguish capability demos from true performance gains.
key_points.silo_note: Monte Carlo acceleration claims are easy to overstate; these benchmarking cautions matter because simulation workloads need fair comparisons against classical Monte Carlo baselines and clear reporting of preprocessing and platform assumptions.
